body.segment: In the field of urban transport, supercapacitors are submitted to relative high charge and discharge currents and therefore significant heat generation occurs.
It has been shown that the temperature has a great influence on the aging mechanism of supercapacitors and, by consequence, on the lifetime of the system.
That is why the thermal management becomes a key issue in the study of the performance of a supercapacitors stack.
In this paper, thermal modeling of a supercapacitors stack is presented and a matrix representation of the model is deduced.
Validation of the model has been carried out using measurement on a developed test bench.
Sensitivity of the model according to input uncertainties is finally discussed.
